limits: JoinSet ownership aborts child tasks on owner drop; abort is scheduled, not synchronously joined. Completed child task errors remain discarded in these pre-existing test fixtures.
The raw observer is a bounded HEADERS-attempt oracle, not a complete H2 protocol validator or browser parity proof.
A frame-boundary clean close or one-second idle interval supports scoped absence only. Partial frame bytes are errors.
The valid-header baseline control is valid HPACK GET/https/path data. It lacks authority/Host and END_STREAM before EOF, so it does not independently establish a fully valid HTTP request.
Real UDP round-trip controls establish active pumps and cancellation closure with a live client. They do not separately prove that the partial capsule reached the decoder before cancellation.
Old H3 proxy implementation and all unrelated integration support are outside full-read scope.
